name: alphasmo
description: AlphaSMO: The Ultimate Smart Money API for AI — CLI + MCP server for 13F institutional holdings, insider trading, and smart-money convergence signals.
long_description: AlphaSMO tracks institutional money flow — 13F filings and insider (Form 4) transactions — and turns it into real-time, ready-to-use data for AI agents. This MCP server is the public gateway to the same production data that powers https://alphasmo.com, a live institutional-holdings and smart-money tracking platform used by investors and researchers. 7 tools cover institution search/profiles/holdings, stock overview and flows, insider activity by ticker, and smart-money convergence. Free anonymous tier out of the box; pass an API key from https://alphasmo.com/developer for higher rate limits.

alphasmo_api_key.title: AlphaSMO API Key
alphasmo_api_key.description: Optional. Raises the rate limit above the free anonymous tier. Get one at https://alphasmo.com/developer.
